name: Viladecans (Spain)
description: Green field with a red canton of half the height and length charged with a white cross throughout.
history: The official flag of Viladecans is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a red canton of half the height and length of the cloth charged with a white cross throughout 1/12 of the height thick; the red flag with a white cross is an attribute of Saint John the Baptist, patron of Viladecans, taken from the arms approved on 27 June 1994 (DOGC no. 1918 of 8 July 1994).

features.role: canton of half the height and length
cross throughout on the canton, 1/12 of the height
